title: Verbs with Fixed Prepositions: consistir en, derivar en, tratarse de, abogar por
goal: Use consistir en, derivar en, tratarse de and abogar por with their own prepositions.
grammar: consistir en, derivar en, tratarse de, abogar por

items: I can use *consistir en*, *derivar en*, *tratarse de* and *abogar por* with the right preposition.
I can tell *derivar en* (result) from *derivar de* (origin).
I can tell *tratar de* (to try to) from *tratarse de* (to be about).
